title: Month-over-month payroll and contractor expense bridge
prompt: Explain the change in payroll and contractor expenses month over month, separating headcount, rate changes, one-time costs and timing.

inputs.name: Payroll register for the month and the prior month
Contractor invoices and bills for the month and the prior month

steps: pull the payroll and contractor expense lines from the general ledger for the month and the prior month
run column_map over the payroll register and the headcount report to align employee, pay type and amount columns
bridge the change: headcount (joiners and leavers), rate changes (same person, different rate), one-time costs (bonuses, severance, true-ups) and timing (pay dates, accruals, invoice dates)
match contractor invoices by vendor across the two months and classify each change the same way
write the workbook; individual pay appears only in the Detail sheet and the summary names no person

done.text: The register and headcount columns map without ambiguity
Every exception row cites the employee id or vendor id and the register row or bill id
payroll-bridge.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The four buckets sum to the month-over-month change with no residual; pay data stays in the Detail sheet; the summary names no individual
